footer_demo_notice: Iyi ni porogaramu y'urugero yakozwe mu mashuri makuru. Ibiri kuri uru rubuga n'amahirwe agaragara ni ingero, si ibisubizo nyabyo.
hero_subtitle: Amahirwe ifasha abanyeshuri kumenya ubushobozi bwabo, bakahurizwa n'abajyanama (mentors) beemejwe, kandi bakabona amahirwe abafasha gukura.
how_it_works_subtitle: Intambwe eshatu zoroshye, zikora n'igihe nta murandasi uhari.
step_discover_body: Ukora ibibazo bigufi kandi byoroshye (hariho cyangwa hatariho murandasi) kugira umenye impano yawe.
step_connect_body: Uhurizwa n'umujyanama (mentor) wemejwe, byemezwa n'umwarimu wawe mbere y'uko muhurira.
step_grow_body: Kurikirana iterambere ryawe, ubone ibimenyetso by'intsinzi, n'amahirwe y'amashuri cyangwa ibindi.
why_body: Abanyeshuri benshi b'impano bo mu cyaro ntibigera babona amahirwe yo kuboneka. Amahirwe iha buri munyeshuri uburyo bworoshye bwo kuboneka, gufashwa, no guhurizwa n'abantu bashobora kubafasha gukura, mu Kinyarwanda mbere ya byose.
opportunities_body: Abajyanama n'abatanga amahirwe bemejwe basangiza amashuri, amarushanwa, n'amahirwe y'akazi. Buri guhuza n'umujyanama bisuzumwa n'umwarimu mbere, kugira ngo abanyeshuri barinzwe.
final_cta_body: Bifata iminota mike gutangira, nta murandasi ukenewe.
footer_rights: © 2026 Amahirwe. Yakorewe abanyeshuri bo mu Rwanda.
offline_message: Nta murandasi ufite. Ibyo wakoze bibitswe kuri iyi telefone kandi bizohererezwa iyo ugarutse kuri murandasi.
auth_login_subtitle: Injira kugira ngo ukomeze kuri dashboard yawe.
auth_register_subtitle: Injira muri Amahirwe umenye impano yawe kandi ubone amahirwe.
